changeSet.author: ttn
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE proposal ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), violation_id UUID REFERENCES violation(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, company_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, entity_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, entity_ref VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, action_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (action_type IN ('UPDATE_FIELD','ADJUSTMENT_ENTRY','MARK_DUPLICATE','CANCEL_VOUCHER')), before_data JSONB NOT NULL, after_data JSONB NOT NULL, changes JSONB NOT NULL, rationale TEXT NOT NULL, citations JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', verification JSONB NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','SUPERSEDED','EXPORTED')), created_by_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (created_by_type IN ('AGENT','USER')), created_by UUID REFERENCES app_user(id), reviewed_by UUID REFERENCES app_user(id), reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, review_note TEXT, exported_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT ck_proposal_reject_note CHECK (status <> 'REJECTED' OR review_note IS NOT NULL) ); CREATE INDEX idx_proposal_company_status ON proposal (company_id, status, created_at DESC); CREATE INDEX idx_proposal_violation ON proposal (violation_id);
